title: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade
abstract: arXiv:2608.14650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. translated_title: 预测驱动的中到全规模世界模型级联的配对精确重置评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14650v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现有的自适应推理和世界动作模型系统使用廉价阶段的输出或预测的未来来分配额外的计算。我们研究一个更窄的问题：在配对精确重置的物理结果下，中规模派生的接口能否预测何时切换到单独冻结的全规模预测器，以改善特定任务决策损失，从而证明顺序开销的合理性？我们的贡献是一个配对评估和审计协议，而不是新的通用路由规则：所有候选动作从相同的重置状态执行，中规模和全规模作用于相同的候选集和任务，它们的配对物理损失差异定义了路由目标。在一个全新的PushT库（V106；1,600个状态，39个任务，三对检查点）上，一个冻结的预测接口路由器相对于单独的中规模、单独的全规模以及一个延迟优势的任务专用路由器，降低了包含开销的决策成本。然后我们前瞻性地密封了第二个1,600个状态的评估集。
tldr: 本文提出了一种配对精确重置的评估协议，通过中规模预测接口决定何时切换到全规模模型，在PushT基准上显著降低了包含计算开销的决策成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a paired exact-reset evaluation protocol where a medium-scale prediction interface decides when to switch to a full-scale model, significantly reducing overhead-inclusive decision costs on the PushT benchmark.
